duty.quote: Whenever you use AI tools, you must keep and provide records that identify the AI used, reference it appropriately and describe how you adapted the outputs to produce your own work.

contents.quote: describe how you adapted the outputs to produce your own work.
a full record of all the AI tools and prompts you used
an explanation of where and how you used and modified that content in your assignment.

location.quote: Submit an appendix with your assessment containing a full record of all the AI tools and prompts you used, the AI-generated content and an explanation of where and how you used and modified that content in your assignment.

records.quote: you must keep and provide records that identify the AI used

referencing.quote: Find out how to cite information from an AI platform in APA Style

consequence.quote: if the tool is used to generate work that is not your own and which you do not disclose, this may be regarded as a breach of academic integrity.
